portfolio_about_paragraph_1: Senior Angular Frontend Developer with 5+ years of professional experience since June 2021, building and maintaining large-scale production web applications. I specialise in modern Angular architecture — Standalone Components, Signals, SSR / Angular Universal, RxJS and TypeScript — applied through Domain-Driven Design with facade, repository and store layers.
portfolio_about_paragraph_2: Most of my work is bilingual Arabic/English (RTL/LTR): healthcare and telehealth platforms, enterprise dashboards, ERP modules and corporate sites. That includes real-time chat and notifications on Socket.io and Pusher, live voice and video sessions via the Agora RTC SDK, and frontend integration of AI chat across text and voice.
portfolio_about_paragraph_3: I've worked with Angular from 16 through 21 and keep adopting the latest releases. Beyond features I care about reusable component systems, SSR-correct SEO, Core Web Vitals and WCAG accessibility — the parts that decide whether a platform still works two years later.
